title: argyranthemum grandiflorum
intro: Argyranthemum grandiflorum, commonly known as the marguerite, is a flowering plant species native to the Canary Islands and the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Argyranthemum grandiflorum are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
